title: Black Lagoon (TV series) — Survival, Reproduction, Illusion #Shorts
description:
What looks like free choice in Black Lagoon (TV series) is older than choice itself. Black Lagoon (stylized in all caps) is a Japanese anime television series based on the manga series Black Lagoon by Rei Hiroe. The series was directed and written by Sunao Katabuchi, with Masanori Shino designing the characters and Edison composing the music.
